note: Vendored verbatim from the installed plugin so CI, which has no plugin, validates against the same protocol offline. The pin is the plugin version plus canonical_sha256 - a digest of the schema re-serialised as canonical JSON, which survives git's line-ending normalisation and any reformatting while still changing the instant the protocol does. tests/test_review_handoff.py compares this copy against the installed plugin wherever one is present, so an upgrade surfaces as a failure rather than as silent drift.
